data.notes: February’s confirmed music calendar in Saint-Barthélemy centered on Carnival in Gustavia, with a few verified DJ and concert dates around the island.

events.title: Carnival Déboulé: Rasta Colors
events.venueName: Pif-Paf kiosk and streets of Gustavia
events.summary: A Saturday night pre-Carnival déboulé through Gustavia, with the 2026 theme listed as Rasta colors: red, green and yellow. St Barth Weekly notes the déboulés start at 8pm at the Pif-Paf kiosk and move through town to rhythmic drums.

events.title: Greg Cerrone at Nikki Beach St Barth
events.summary: French-American DJ and producer Greg Cerrone was listed for a February 12 performance at Nikki Beach in Gustavia. Songkick listed the event with doors at 14:00 and Greg Cerrone as headliner.

events.title: Carnival Déboulé: Lighting Parade / Fluorescent Love
events.venueName: Pif-Paf kiosk and streets of Gustavia
events.summary: The February 14 pre-Carnival déboulé was confirmed with a lighting parade / “fluorescent love” theme. St Barth Weekly describes the 2026 déboulés as Saturday night processions through Gustavia with rhythmic drums.

events.title: Carnaval: An Pyjama Lévé
events.venueName: Pif-Paf kiosk and streets of Gustavia
events.summary: The traditional pre–Mardi Gras pajama parade was confirmed for Monday night, February 16, with The Youngz leading a procession through Gustavia. The Journal de Saint-Barth listed the meeting point as 20:00 in front of Pif-Paf.

events.title: Carnaval 2026: Mardi Gras Grande Parade and After DJs
events.venueName: Gustavia streets and Quai du Général de Gaulle
events.summary: The main Mardi Gras parade in Gustavia was confirmed for February 17 with eight floats, dancers and Caribbean music. An official carnival after-party was listed on Quai du Général de Gaulle from 19:00 to 23:00, animated by DJs Mæstro, Big Boss and El Coch.

events.title: Carnaval: Brulé Vaval / Ash Wednesday Final Parade
events.venueName: The Select to Shell Beach, Gustavia
events.summary: The Carnival closing ritual, Brulé Vaval, was confirmed for Wednesday, February 18. The Journal de Saint-Barth reported the procession would leave around 20:00 from The Select toward Shell Beach to the sound of drums before the burning of Vaval.

events.title: Trio Idilio in Concert
events.summary: Trio Idilio performed on Friday, February 20, from 19:00 to 21:00 at the École de musique Alcide Terrac in Colombier. The donation-entry concert supported Saint-Barth Harmony’s “Saint-Barth Harmony invite Cuba” project.
